description.en: Animates a camera's depth-of-field "DepthLevel" parameter (see CMND_SET_CAMERA_PARAM) to a target value over a number of frames.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Animate the camera's depth level to a new value
CMND_DEPTHLEVEL_FADE(hCam, EV_TALK_DP_LVL, _frame);
